description:
Title: Service for Your Fridge

Your fridge produces strange noises.
You describe the symptoms, and send them together with the type of fridge to the central fridge service center.
They select a local service facility (which all have their own way of interacting with customers).
The service facility makes an appointment.
They arrive at a random time, and sometimes have to leave without repairing your fridge, because they need additional parts.
After your fridge is repaired, you have to confirm that it is OK again.
You can rate the service facility.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_FridgeService" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/fridge-service">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Symptoms" name="Fridge symptoms and type"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ServiceRequest" name="Service request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Appointment" name="Appointment proposal"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Repaired" name="Fridge repaired"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_FridgeService">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_CentralCenter" name="Central Fridge Service Center" processRef="Process_CentralCenter"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Facility" name="Local Service Facility" processRef="Process_ServiceFacility"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Symptoms" name="Send symptoms and fridge type" sourceRef="SendTask_SendSymptoms" targetRef="StartEvent_Request" messageRef="Msg_Symptoms"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ServiceRequest" name="Forward service request" sourceRef="SendTask_ForwardRequest" targetRef="StartEvent_ServiceRequest" messageRef="Msg_ServiceRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Appointment" name="Appointment proposal" sourceRef="SendTask_SendAppointment" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_AppointmentReceived" messageRef="Msg_Appointment"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Repaired" name="Fridge repaired" sourceRef="SendTask_NotifyRepaired" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_RepairCompleted" messageRef="Msg_Repaired"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Customer" name="Fridge makes strange noises">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DescribeSymptoms" name="Describe symptoms">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendSymptoms" name="Send symptoms and fridge type" messageRef="Msg_Symptoms">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatchEvent_AppointmentReceived" name="Appointment proposed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C4</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_AppointmentReceived" messageRef="Msg_Appointment"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatchEvent_RepairCompleted" name="Fridge repaired">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C5</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_RepairCompleted" messageRef="Msg_Repaired"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_ConfirmRepair" name="Confirm fridge is working again">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RateDecision_Split" name="Rate service facility?" default="Flow_C8">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C7</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RateFacility" name="Rate service facility">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RateDecision_Join" name="Rating decision done">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Customer" name="Service completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C10</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Customer" targetRef="Task_DescribeSymptoms"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C2" sourceRef="Task_DescribeSymptoms" targetRef="SendTask_SendSymptoms"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C3" sourceRef="SendTask_SendSymptoms" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_AppointmentReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C4" sourceRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_AppointmentReceived" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_RepairCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C5" sourceRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_RepairCompleted" targetRef="UserTask_ConfirmRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C6" sourceRef="UserTask_ConfirmRepair" targetRef="Gateway_RateDecision_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C7" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RateDecision_Split" targetRef="Task_RateFacility">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${wantsToRate == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C8" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RateDecision_Split" targetRef="Gateway_RateDecision_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C9" sourceRef="Task_RateFacility" targetRef="Gateway_RateDecision_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C10" sourceRef="Gateway_RateDecision_Join" targetRef="EndEvent_Customer"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_CentralCenter" name="Central Fridge Service Center" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Request" name="Symptoms received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_R1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_SymptomsReceived" messageRef="Msg_Symptoms"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectFacility" name="Select local service facility">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_R1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_R2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ForwardRequest" name="Forward service request to facility" messageRef="Msg_ServiceRequest">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_R2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_R3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Central" name="Facility selected">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_R3</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Request" targetRef="Task_SelectFacility"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R2" sourceRef="Task_SelectFacility" targetRef="SendTask_ForwardRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R3" sourceRef="SendTask_ForwardRequest" targetRef="EndEvent_Central"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_ServiceFacility" name="Local Service Facility" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ServiceRequest" name="Service request received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_F1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_RequestReceived" messageRef="Msg_ServiceRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MakeAppointment" name="Make appointment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_F1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_F2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendAppointment" name="Send appointment to customer" messageRef="Msg_Appointment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_F2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_F3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_VisitCustomer" name="Arrive at customer at random time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_F3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_F7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_F4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Repaired_Split" name="Fridge repaired?" default="Flow_F6">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_F4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_F5</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_F6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RepairFridge" name="Repair fridge">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_F5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_F8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LeaveWithoutRepair" name="Leave without repair (additional parts needed)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_F6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_F7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_NotifyRepaired" name="Notify customer fridge is repaired" messageRef="Msg_Repaired">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_F8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_F9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Facility" name="Service job closed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_F9</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F1" sourceRef="StartEvent_ServiceRequest" targetRef="Task_MakeAppointment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F2" sourceRef="Task_MakeAppointment" targetRef="SendTask_SendAppointment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F3" sourceRef="SendTask_SendAppointment" targetRef="Task_VisitCustomer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F4" sourceRef="Task_VisitCustomer" targetRef="Gateway_Repaired_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F5" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Repaired_Split" targetRef="Task_RepairFridge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${fridgeRepaired == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F6" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Repaired_Split" targetRef="Task_LeaveWithoutRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F7" sourceRef="Task_LeaveWithoutRepair" targetRef="Task_VisitCustomer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F8" sourceRef="Task_RepairFridge" targetRef="SendTask_NotifyRepaired"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F9" sourceRef="SendTask_NotifyRepaired" targetRef="EndEvent_Facility"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
